red_noiselevel.pro


Routines

top source red_noiselevel

SST pipeline

result = red_noiselevel(Pic [, OversamplingRate=float] [, LimFreq=float] [, /Fourier])

Measure the standard deviation of white noise in an image.

Measures the level of the power spectrum of pic, in the area where there should be no signal and no dreadful cross.

Return value

Noise stddev in counts.

Parameters

Pic in type=array

The image in which to measure the noise level. If Pic is 2D, then return a scalar. If Pic is 3D, assume array has dimensions [sz,sz,Nim] and return array with Nim noise levels.

Keywords

OversamplingRate in optional type=float

The oversampling factor, limfreq/Nyquist.

LimFreq in optional type=float

The diffraction limit in pixels.

Fourier in optional type=boolean

Pic is the Fourier transform of an image.
